title: Nighttime Sunwatch
text:
🌕 Nighttime Sunwatch — October 20, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B5.4)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.4 (Peaked October 20, 2026 at 18:36 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 396 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Unsettled (Kp 3.00)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

Easy going out there. 💛

Several sunspot and active-region concentrations are visible, while the coronagraph shows a routine streamer pattern.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
